text:
Predicates:
SpottedNearCampus(x) ::: x can be spotted near the campus.
Rabbit(x) ::: x is a rabbit.
Cute(x) ::: x is cute.
Turtle(x) ::: x is a turtle.
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
Skittish(x) ::: x is skittish.
Calm(x) ::: x is calm.
Squirrel(x) ::: x is a squirrel.
Rockie ::: Rockie is an individual.

Premises:
∀x (SpottedNearCampus(x) ∧ Rabbit(x) → Cute(x)) ::: All rabbits that can be spotted near the campus are cute.
∃x (Turtle(x) ∧ SpottedNearCampus(x)) ::: Some turtles can be spotted near the campus.
∀x (SpottedNearCampus(x) ∧ Squirrel(x) → Skittish(x)) ::: All squirrels that can be spotted near the campus are skittish.
SpottedNearCampus(Rockie) ::: Rockie can be spotted near the campus.
Calm(Rockie) ::: Rockie is calm.

Conclusion:
Rockie is a turtle ∨ Cute(Rockie) ::: Rockie is a turtle or Rockie is cute.
